notes.title: Minor Update v.1.0.0.7.7
notes.content:
In this version, we:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that may freeze the game on S6+9-A3
[*] Fixed a bug that may cause some levels won't unlock correctly
[/list]

Welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/k9x7CUgd]Discord[/url]（Puzzle-Games Group）and leave your feedback. Thank you!
